text:
maya: Heads up — ~30% of eu-west warm-pool GPUs failed to finish bootstrap this morning. node-agent logs show keystore handshake timeout after the firewall change. KMS decrypt events missing for those hosts.
ops-bot: alert: warm-pool-failure eu-west-1c metric spike :rotating_light:
raj: I tightened outbound rules on the NAT subnet SGs yesterday to block 0.0.0.0/0 443 except for privatelink. Might have been too narrow for the keystore proxy.
kira: Can you paste the node-agent log snippet and confirm which keystore endpoint the nodes are using (privatelink vs public)?
maya: Log snippet from affected node (short):
```
2024-05-14T08:01:23 node-agent[1234]: keystore: handshake timeout after 10s to privatelink-keystore.internal:443
2024-05-14T08:01:33 node-agent[1234]: decrypt failed: context deadline exceeded
2024-05-14T08:01:35 node-agent[1234]: healthcheck: failed keystore handshake
```
Nodes are configured to use the privatelink endpoint (svc-keystore-eu) via interface endpoints in the warm-pool subnets. audit-bot shows no kms:Decrypt events for hostids i-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 etc.
audit-bot: audit: missing kms:Decrypt events for hostids [i-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890, i-0f9e8d7c6b5a43210] — see SEC-4532 attachment.
sam: Impact note — autoscaler spun up 12 on-demand nodes this morning because warm-pool couldn't finish bootstrap; rough extra cost ~+$1.6k for the window. We should avoid churn by gate-checking keystore before deeming node healthy.
raj: I'm going to roll a firewall rollback for one AZ (eu-west-1c) to confirm. Will open outbound 443 to the privatelink-keystore IP range for the warm-pool SG and restart node-agent. ETA ~10m.
security-bot: Reminder: any temporary egress exceptions need a security ticket with justification and retention plan. Create SEC ticket and tag it with retention:30d. @security please review.
maya: Created SEC-4532 and uploaded logs + timeline. Also starting tcpdump on an affected instance to capture the handshake: 
```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host 10.12.34.56 and port 443 -w /tmp/keystore-handshake.pcap
```
kira: After rollback, we should restart node-agent and requeue the warm-pool entry: `systemctl restart node-agent && /usr/local/bin/warmpoolctl requeue`. That should force a rebootstrap attempt.
raj: Rollback applied for eu-west-1c — egress to privatelink-keystore IPs allowed on warm-pool SG. Restarted node-agent on 5 affected hosts, requeued 6. Monitoring now.
ops-bot: metric: keystore-handshake-timeouts (eu-west-1c) down to baseline in 3m :white_check_mark:
maya: Verified: audit now shows kms:Decrypt events for the affected host IDs and warm-pool capacity returned to normal. Will follow up with a short postmortem and firewall rule refinement (CIDR narrow + prefer VPC endpoints only). :thumbsup:
leo: Follow-up proposal — add a health probe pre-check for warm-pool requeue that validates keystore handshake (quick TLS connect + decrypt test) to avoid autoscaler churn in the future.
maya: Agreed. I'll add the probe to the warm-pool health-check epic and sync with security for the probe's KMS usage pattern. :eyes:
